lesson.title: Kubernetes from Zero, part 12: checkpoint lab 1, a two-tier app on kind
lesson.description: A timed, CKAD-style lab: build a web and Redis app with a Secret, ConfigMaps, probes, resources and Services, then grade it with a script. Full solutions.
lesson.tested: Built, broke and graded the full solution on kind v0.33.0, node v1.37.0, kubectl v1.37.2, 10 Nov 2026
lesson.rule: If you can build this app from an empty namespace in 45 minutes and every check passes, you have the foundations; if a check fails, the table tells you which part to reread.

boards.title: What the lab builds
boards.hint: from the recap and the cheat sheet

rows.name: Secret redis-auth
rows.role: Created from a literal. The key is `password`.
rows.where: create it before the redis Pod

rows.name: Deployment redis
rows.role: One ready replica, image `redis:8.10-alpine`, a readiness probe, Guaranteed QoS.

rows.name: ConfigMap web-files
rows.role: `index.html` and the CGI script `hits`, mounted so `hits` is mode 0755.
rows.where: without the mode, httpd will not run the script

rows.name: Deployment web
rows.role: 2 replicas of `busybox:1.37`, readiness on `/index.html`, a TCP liveness probe, preStop of 5 seconds, Burstable.
rows.where: restart is one at a time

rows.name: Service web
rows.role: Port 80 targets 8080. The short name `http://web` works in the same namespace.

rows.name: client
rows.role: `kubectl run client --image=busybox:1.37 -- sleep 3600`, then wget from it.

steps.title: Failures the lesson hit on purpose

items.what: Applying `redis.yaml` before the Secret leaves the Pod in `CreateContainerConfigError`: `secret "redis-auth" not found`. Create the Secret. The kubelet retries, and the Pod was Running about 20 seconds later.

Leaving out `mode: 0755` mounts the script as `-rw-r--r--`. busybox httpd will not run it, so `/cgi-bin/hits` returns 404 while `index.html` works. The Pods stay ready, because the readiness probe only checks `index.html`.
`nc` without `-w 2` hung for minutes while Redis was replaced. With `-w 2` the same situation returns within seconds.

Readiness and graceful shutdown together gave zero failed requests during a full rolling restart in the lab. The counter vanished when Redis restarted, because nothing in arc 1 keeps data outside a container.

commands.note: one at a time, per the rollout strategy

homework.intro: The lab is 45 minutes, from an empty namespace, on the kind cluster from part 3. Task 1 creates `k8s-from-zero`. Try the tasks before you read the solutions. Answers are in the separate answer key.

sections.title: Recall
sections.hint: Answer from memory, then check the lesson.

exercises.q: What did the lab build, in the recap's list?
exercises.a: A two-tier app from an empty namespace: Deployments, Services, a Secret, two ConfigMaps, probes, a preStop hook and sized resources.

exercises.q: How do you make the redis Pod Guaranteed, and how do you check?
exercises.a: Requests equal limits for cpu and memory. Check `.status.qosClass`.

exercises.q: Why did the counter vanish when Redis restarted?
exercises.a: Nothing in arc 1 keeps data outside a container. Part 13 gives Redis storage that outlives its Pod.

sections.title: Predict the outcome
sections.hint: These are the failures recorded in the lesson.

exercises.q: You apply `redis.yaml` before the Secret. What status and error does the lesson show, and what fixes it?
exercises.a: `CreateContainerConfigError`, and describe shows `Error: secret "redis-auth" not found`. Create the Secret. The kubelet retries.

exercises.q: `/cgi-bin/hits` returns 404 and `index.html` works. What was missing, and why is the Pod still ready?
exercises.a: `mode: 0755`. The script was mounted as `-rw-r--r--` and busybox httpd would not run it. The readiness probe only checks `index.html`.

exercises.q: A client wget prints `bad address 'web'`. What three things does the lesson tell you to check?
exercises.a: The client is in the same namespace, the Service exists, and the CoreDNS Pods are running in `kube-system`.
